description: This header file defines exported APIs for the TLS Alert Handler component within a Transport Layer Security implementation. It includes function prototypes for creating and initializing the alert handler object, suggesting its role in TLS alert management.

methods.name: TlsCreateAlertHandler
methods.description: Creates a TLS Alert Handler object with provided container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: TlsAhoCreate
methods.description: Instantiates a TLS Alert Handler object with specified contexts.

methods.name: TlsAhoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the TLS Alert Handler object.
